tasks.title: Inventory every outbound and persistence sink
tasks.scope: Enumerate network calls, external navigation, URL construction, mailto links, clipboard writes, downloads, browser storage, console output, and any serialization of study or browser metadata.
tasks.verification: Every sink class has a repository-wide search and each match is classified by source data, destination, user gesture, and persistence surface.

tasks.title: Trace sensitive data into each sink
tasks.scope: Trace feedback prose, complete study JSON, narrative text, browser metadata, identifiers, and configuration values from producers through every outbound or persistent consumer; distinguish confirmed leaks from explicit local exports and configured model requests.
tasks.verification: Adversarially test for sensitive URL query/hash/referrer/history exposure and unprompted network transmission; record exact file and line evidence.

tasks.title: Report confirmed risks and safe paths
tasks.scope: Re-scan built and source paths, prioritize confirmed findings, document intentional exports, and state any limitations. Do not change app behavior during this audit.
tasks.verification: The report separates confirmed exposure, conditional/configured transmission, local-only persistence, and false positives, with actionable remediation.
